# ASL-LEX 2.0

`signdata.csv` and `signdataKEY.csv` from the ASL-LEX 2.0 OSF project
(https://osf.io/zpha4/, Data Files folder), downloaded 2026-11-22.

Sehyr, Caselli, Cohen-Goldberg & Emmorey (2021). The ASL-LEX 2.0 Project:
A Database of Lexical and Phonological Properties for 2,723 Signs in American
Sign Language. Journal of Deaf Studies and Deaf Education 26(2), 263-277.

Used by `scripts/build_sign_catalog.py` for each sign's ASL-CDI membership and
semantic category (`InCDI`, `CDISemanticCategory`) and frequency
(`SignFrequency(M)`, deaf signers' ratings, 1-7).
